source: The 2026-11-18 navego.pages.dev rebrand and consistency pass: logo, wordmark, eyebrows, type and spacing system, nav notch, copy pass. User direction arrived 2026-11-18; internet sources were verified 2026-11-18. Repo sources point at the docs that already carry the decision.
note: One decision, one source. Code references this file as `decisions.json → D<n>`. A decision the user asked for carries kind=user; a decision nobody asked for carries the internet source it was taken from; a decision inherited from this repo carries the repo document that already carries it.

decisions.decision: The body text is 14 px on every page.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: 'biasanya sih 14 yang teks'

decisions.decision: The type scale uses even pixel steps only: 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 24, 28, 32, 40, 64.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: 'jika misalnya heading 1 heading 2 dan seterusnya gunakan ukuran genap dan konsisten'

decisions.decision: h1 is 40 px (hero 64 px on /beranda, 28 px on ≤860 px), h2 is 28 px, h3 is 20 px, h4 is 18 px.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18 (even-size rule)

decisions.decision: Line heights are unitless: display 1.1, heading 1.25, body 1.5, small 1.4.

source.ref: https://practicaltypography.com/line-spacing.html (120-145% of point size)

decisions.decision: Running text meets the 1.5 line-height floor so it survives visitor overrides.

source.ref: https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/text-spacing.html (criterion 1.4.12, AA)

decisions.decision: Text fills the width of its container; no 18ch/44ch/46ch/66ch/68ch/72ch measure caps anywhere.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: 'lebarnya full bukan yang terpotong di tengah' and the follow-up option 'Konten tidak dibatasi terlalu sempit'
source.also: https://practicaltypography.com/line-length.html (45-90 characters, the rule this overrides by owner decision)

decisions.decision: Text is flush left; horizontal centering is kept only for symmetric fixed-box icons and figures.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: 'alignment mana yang harus alignment kiri mana yang harus tengah semua harus konsisten'

decisions.decision: Paragraph → paragraph spacing is 1 em.

source.ref: https://practicaltypography.com/space-between-paragraphs.html (50-100% of the point size)

decisions.decision: A heading gets more space above (32 px, larger than paragraph spacing, so it stands out) and less below (12 px, smaller than paragraph spacing, so it bonds to its text).

source.ref: https://practicaltypography.com/space-above-and-below.html

decisions.decision: The spacing scale is multiples of 4 px: 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 72, 104.

source.ref: https://material.io/design/layout/spacing-methods.html (8dp grid, 4dp nested units, 4dp type baseline)

decisions.decision: The gutter is 20 px, 32 px at ≥940 px — one fixed even step each, no fractional vw.

source.ref: https://material.io/design/layout/spacing-methods.html (4-px base unit, both values sit on the grid)

decisions.decision: Body/UI type is Tahoma, Verdana, system-ui; mono is Lucida Console — the zero-download system stack the Y2K house face ships.

source.ref: docs/design-elements.md (Corporate Y2K done flat: cream ground, deep navy ink, one amber accent)

decisions.decision: Display type is Arial Black, weight 900, letter-spacing -0.02em.

source.ref: docs/design-elements.md (the era's display face)

decisions.decision: Ground is cream #f6f1e7, ink is navy-deep #0d1338, the one warm accent is amber #d8923f.

source.ref: docs/design-elements.md (Corporate Y2K done flat)

decisions.decision: Amber is the single warm accent; everything else stays in the navy/cream system.

source.ref: docs/design-elements.md (one amber accent)

decisions.decision: :focus-visible carries a 3 px outline, 3 px offset; on navy surfaces the ring goes amber.

source.ref: https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG21/Understanding/focus-visible.html (WCAG 2.4.7)

decisions.decision: Buttons hold a 44 px minimum block size.

source.ref: https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/buttons (at least 44x44 pt hit region)

decisions.decision: Button padding is 12 px × 24 px; small button 8 px × 16 px; chips 4 px × 12 px — even pixel steps on the 4-px grid.

source.ref: https://material.io/design/layout/spacing-methods.html (4dp nested units)

decisions.decision: Radius steps stay even and few: 14 px panels, 10 px controls.

source.ref: https://material.io/design/layout/spacing-methods.html (4-px base unit, both values are multiples of 2)

decisions.decision: Flat surfaces carry no shadows; the one floating element (the nav notch) carries the one shadow and the one gradient on the site.

source.ref: docs/design-elements.md (flat modern)
source.also: user 2026-11-18 (the notch redesign with its effect)

decisions.decision: The nav notch is always visible at every width; compact widths collapse the flat row into it; hover or focus drops the full link strip; amber glow on hover/focus is the effect; the chevron turns amber with it.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: 'tampilkan notch di semua lebar layar kemudian redesign bentuk notch menjadi modern dan memiliki efek'

decisions.decision: The sticky header hides while scrolling down and returns on the way up; it stays put while focused.

source.ref: site/app/brand.css (site-header scroll-state, pre-existing behaviour)

decisions.decision: Numbers in tables align right and use tabular figures; body text stays left.

source.ref: site/app/brand.css (.num, tabular-nums)

decisions.decision: prefers-reduced-motion disables smooth scrolling and transitions.

source.ref: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/@media/prefers-reduced-motion

decisions.decision: text-wrap: balance on headings, pretty on prose.

source.ref: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/text-wrap

decisions.decision: The footer hands out an 88x31 badge; the size is the early-web link-back convention.

source.ref: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Web_badge (88x31 web badges)

decisions.decision: The header hides via a container scroll-state query so it does not depend on JS.

source.ref: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/@container/scroll-state

decisions.decision: The mark is one hand-drawn stroke: left stem, the diagonal (top-left to bottom-right), right stem, each with a slight human bow — never ruler-straight.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: pick D, fix the reversed stroke direction, then 'buat huruf N pada logo lebih natural seperti coretan manusia'

decisions.decision: The amber underline below the N is one symmetric arc, centred on 120.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: 'betulkan juga garis stroke di bawahnya agar simetris'

decisions.decision: The wordmark is the same hand: single-stroke round-capped letters, one motion per glyph, no tittle over the g.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: 'kata navego buat jadi tulisan tangan'; 'di atas huruf g tidak perlu ada titik'; 'tulisan tangan navego buat konsisten untuk stylenya'

decisions.decision: The letters a and e are drawn to read unmistakably (closed bowl plus stem for a; loop plus crossbar for e) — a wordmark nobody can read is decoration, not a wordmark.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: 'huruf a dan e masih belum bisa terbaca'

decisions.decision: One mark everywhere: components, favicon (icon.svg), standalone mark (navego-mark.svg), 88x31 badge, og-cover.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: 'satu mark di semua tempat'

decisions.decision: The mark palette is fixed: disc #233259, stroke #f4f1e9, accent #d8923f (badge uses the reversed navy-on-cream form).

source.ref: docs/design-elements.md (navy disc, chrome, amber accent); site/app/components/NavegoMark.tsx (current art)

decisions.decision: No Huginn & Muninn anywhere; the footer line is 'Navego — Browser Anda, atas perintah Anda.' and the auth panel carries the logo lockup, not a myth label.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: 'ganti huginn & muninn dengan navego dan logonya'

decisions.decision: No eyebrows, kickers or crumbs above headings, anywhere — the heading is the first thing on the page.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18 (beranda screenshot, then 'hapus semua eyebrows no eyebrows')

decisions.decision: The document outline runs h1 → h2 → body; nothing sits above the h1.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: 'agentik browser lokal ada di atas heading satu yang mana itu tidak urut'
source.also: https://design-system.canada.ca/en/styles/typography (heading levels numerically ordered, no skipped levels)

decisions.decision: The middle dot is never used as a separator — commas, dashes or parentheses instead.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: 'pemisah tidak boleh menggunakan titik tengah'

decisions.decision: The login panel opens with the logo lockup, not a label; the h1 stays 'Masuk atau daftar.' in the same place on both phases of the form.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18 (the navego.pages.dev screenshot)

decisions.decision: Every decision in code cites docs/decisions.json as `decisions.json -> D<n>`, or it does not ship; the gate is tests/tooling/decisions.test.ts.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: every decision in code carries a source; the register is one file the code refers back to - "wajib ada link untuk referensi"; enforced repo-wide after the website

decisions.decision: A reason is written as a reason: no comment opens with a WHY prefix; the reason is written directly.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: "langsung kasih reason tanpa why"

decisions.decision: The acceptance surface is not swept and not judged: gates.lock, .gitleaks.toml, .github, the frozen public contract in tests/helpers/boundary-locks.ts, and hosted/migrations; the exclusions are named in tests/tooling/decisions.test.ts and in AGENTS.md, each with its reason.

source.ref: AGENTS.md scope rules 2-4 (a gate that must move is re-pinned in the same commit, with the reason); user 2026-11-18: enforce the rule across the repo without touching the acceptance surface

decisions.decision: Notich and drop-down strip are flat rectangles, square corners, no curves and no gradient; hover or focus tint and one chevron are the whole effect.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: "notchnya masih belum betul aku mau buat jadi minimalis tanpa lekukan"

decisions.decision: One idea per tile, headline of 2-6 words; the supporting line is one sentence; nothing advertises more than one benefit at a time.

source.ref: https://www.apple.com (product tiles: one idea per headline); https://developer.apple.com/app-store/product-page/ (concise informative paragraph); https://marketingexamined.com/blog/how-to-write-copy-like-apple (one big idea per headline; inverted pyramid)

decisions.decision: Sentences average ten to fourteen words; the longest sentence on any page stays under twenty-five; shorter lines carry the same meaning with no orphan clauses.

source.ref: https://yourtechnicalcopywriter.com/copywriting-tips-from-apple (average sentence length of iPhone 5 copy: 10.9, 11.9, 14.0 words); https://marketingexamined.com/blog/how-to-write-copy-like-apple (write for scanners)

decisions.decision: Address the reader in the second person, in the present tense, with verbs that are things the product literally does (read, fill, click, save); no adjectives praising the product, no exclamation marks.

source.ref: https://help.apple.com/pdf/applestyleguide/en_US/apple-style-guide.pdf (Apple style guide: sentence-style headings, second person, active voice); https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2022/10037/ (write like a person, one idea at a time)

decisions.decision: Facts pinned by the site gate survive any rewrite verbatim: Navego, 45, primitive browser, plan.usd-1, PayPal, Enterprise, SHA-256, 1.6.22, docs/releases, browser_status, debugger, Tanpa eval, Kata sandi, SECURITY.md, Diukur bukan diklaim, Google Docs, p50, Apa itu Navego, Berapa harganya, Halaman ini tidak ada, browser Anda, Penyedia, Izin aplikasi, Memeriksa sesi, WebDriver, canvas, Artikel, AI yang mengenal browser, Dukungan, Kebijakan Privasi, Syarat Layanan.

source.ref: tests/site/site.test.ts (CLAIMS); site/app/routes/*.tsx

decisions.decision: The site is written in Indonesian, like the UI it describes; technical terms the product itself uses (browser, MCP, extension, plan, PayPal) stay in English only when the interface shows them in English.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: redesign the site content with internet research for sentence style; product language stayed Indonesian (lang="id" across every route, site.test.ts)

decisions.decision: Inverted pyramid in every section: the claim first, the strongest proof second, the rest last - readers who stop after one line still leave with the right idea.

source.ref: https://marketingexamined.com/blog/how-to-write-copy-like-apple (big headlines showcase one idea, inverted-pyramid paragraphs: biggest benefit to smallest); https://linear.app (claim, then proof, then link)

decisions.decision: The coba section ships the product UI itself: a navy command panel (prompt, typed text, caret, preset chips) and a paper trace panel (numbered primitive steps, always visible) - no submit button hiding the interesting half; the interaction lives in the choice of preset, not in a form submit.

source.ref: https://www.apple.com (product demos ship the interface as the marketing); https://linear.app (the product UI as the marketing); https://www.raycast.com/ (typewriter prompt panel as the hero)

decisions.decision: The chevron panel never repeats what the bar already shows: above 940px it lists only the secondary links (Keamanan, Changelog, FAQ, Metodologi, Bandingkan, Privasi, Syarat); at or below 940px, where the primary row is hidden, it lists every link, five per column in menu order.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: "ini masih dobel kenapa yak" - the panel repeated the eight links already visible in the bar; user wants no duplicate
